sections.Profile:
Lady Robin Hood , released in 1948 by D. Gottlieb & Co., is an electro-mechanical pinball machine known for its innovative design by Harry Mabs, who also pioneered flipper technology in pinball. With six flippers—three on each side—the game stands out as one of the early titles to incorporate this feature after the success of Humpty Dumpty .
